parsed.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall shelves stocked with black crates and white boxes. A person in a yellow safety vest walks toward the camera on a concrete floor marked with blue lines. Orange forklifts are parked in the background. Red safety blocks and overhead lighting are also visible.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Wearing a bright yellow reflective vest over a dark jacket and blue jeans. Walking forward with hands in pockets. Feet in black work boots. Partially obscures foreground. Unclear if wearing gloves. Appears to be moving toward viewer.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall metal racks filled with stacked black plastic crates and white cardboard boxes. Located along both sides of the aisle. Some shelves have red signage. Extends into background. Supports stored goods.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Two orange forklifts parked side-by-side in the background aisle. One partially obscured by shelves. Black tires and control cabins visible. No operator present. Resting on concrete floor.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray surface covering entire ground area. Blue painted lines mark pathways. Shows slight wear. Reflects overhead lights. Person's feet make contact. Forklifts rest on it.

objects.label: red safety block
objects.observation: Large rectangular red block with textured surface. Positioned on right side near pillar. Base rests on concrete. Likely used as a barrier or step. No visible attachments.

objects.label: overhead lighting
objects.observation: Long fluorescent light fixtures mounted high on ceiling. Emit bright white light. Illuminates entire warehouse space. Casts shadows on floor and shelves. Not directly attached to any visible structure.
